meta.name: tfx-ralph
meta.description: tfx-persist의 별칭(alias). 'ralph', '끝까지 해', '멈추지 마' 같은 요청에 사용. 실제 동작은 tfx-persist 스킬이 수행합니다. Use when: ralph, 끝까지, don't stop, 멈추지 마

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 说出特定语句就能唤醒后续的执行流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望用简单口令让任务坚持完成。
copy.tagline_en: Say a phrase to trigger the follow-up process.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a simple phrase to keep tasks going.

howto.what: 该技能是 `tfx-persist` 的别名。Claude 收到后会调用 `tfx-persist`，把用户原请求直接传过去，行为与 `tfx-persist` 完全一样；若请求带 `ARGUMENTS`，则用该值作为第一步输入，否则会先向用户询问。
howto.when: 当你说“ralph”、“끝까지”等关键词，或表达“不要停、继续做”时触发。

say.text: 请 ralph 继续完成这个任务。
say.note: 会调用 tfx-persist，把你的原话传过去。
触发该别名，同样交给 tfx-persist 处理。
等同请求持久执行，由 tfx-persist 接管。

howto.what_en: This skill is an alias for `tfx-persist`. When invoked, Claude calls `tfx-persist` and forwards the user's original request unchanged, so the behavior is exactly the same. If the call includes `ARGUMENTS`, that value is used as the initial input; otherwise Claude asks the user for input.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says keywords like 'ralph', '끝까지', or expresses 'don't stop / keep going'.

say_en.text: Please ralph and finish this task.
say_en.note: Calls tfx-persist with your original request.
Triggers the alias and continues processing.
